verdict.rationale: Linear's own developer docs list importing data from other services into Linear [linear-docs-47], and its official repo ships import tooling for uploading from other systems [linear-docs-101]. Its integrations directory also has a dedicated Jira-to-Linear transition path [linear-intdir-11]. These are first-party, so the core story is delivered, but each mention is a one-liner. missing for 10: which source tools are supported beyond Jira, what data is migrated (issues, comments, attachments, statuses), whether a PM can run an import from the UI without developer tooling, and independent or hands-on confirmation of an import working.
